title: The map, folded
logline: A road map folded to the coast, on the drafting table, the route north traced in pencil from Newport to a city at the top edge, and the pencil line stopping an inch short. The sequence's own map. The inch is the page.

panels.composition: A road map folded to show a coastline on a drafting table with a pencil line traced up the coast road stopping an inch short of a city at the map's top edge, a pencil beside it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a road map folded to show a coastline on a drafting table with a pencil line traced up the coast road stopping an inch short of a city at the top edge, a pencil beside it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
